_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
A recording on a draft goes to it after a reload and keeps its text. In the diff viewer (".diff-viewer-overlay"), "the start button" is data-testid "review-record-start", "the stop button" data-testid "review-record-stop", "the cancel button" data-testid "review-record-cancel", "the status" data-testid "review-recording-status", "where" data-testid "review-recording-where" (its textContent joins its crumbs with no separator) and "said" data-testid "review-recording-said"; "the tooltip" is ".p-tooltip". "Wait for the commit message" means: wait (up to 30s) until a ".diff-viewer-overlay .editor.modified .view-line" containing "Rename value20" is visible; the viewer opens on the repository's HEAD commit {{SHORT}}, which renames line 20 of src/app.ts to "const renamedValue = 20;". {{QUERY}} is the query string that opens the diff viewer on that commit in the repository. "It is sent" means data-testid "review-recording-sent" becomes visible (wait up to 30s: sending takes several requests). "Wait for the clock to start" means: wait until the time element of the stop button no longer reads "00:00" (eval document.querySelector("[data-testid=review-record-stop] time")?.textContent !== "00:00", expect true). There is a draft conversation {{DRAFT_ID}} in the repository, with the unsent text "Written elsewhere." and model predictable. The server refuses audio uploads (/api/upload/raw answers 503 "unavailable") until call "accept uploads". Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/{{DRAFT_ID}}?{{QUERY}} and wait for the commit message.
2. Click the start button, wait for the clock to start, then click the stop button. data-testid "review-recording-error" should be visible.
3. The draft it began on still takes it after a reload: call "accept uploads", navigate to /c/{{DRAFT_ID}}?{{QUERY}} again, and click data-testid "review-recording-send". It is sent.
4. Call "check send" should return exactly "ok": it checks that exactly one chat request was made, to the draft, with model "predictable" and the repository as cwd, and that the server no longer has the draft as a draft.
5. Its unsent text stays in the composer: click the viewer's close button (".diff-viewer-overlay .diff-viewer-close"). The message input's (data-testid "message-input") value should be exactly "Written elsewhere.".
